zh.place: 半月酒吧 临街窗边

zh: 晚上十一点。五部手机一起尖叫，屋里乱成一锅粥。
Nico把第六张账单塞进裤兜。那张折着的留言，还没顾上看。
窗外的雨大得连对面的路灯都看不见了。
红色预警！我念啊——“地铁全线停运，机场高速多处积水”！
他这趟可太必要了。去纽约，一去五年，不回来了嘛。
这话一出，桌上又冷了半秒。
Theo低头刷手机，手指划得飞快。
好消息！我的航班——“暂时正常”。
“暂时”。这俩字可真让人有安全感。
那当然。五年合同，男主角，换你你不高兴？
他嘴上笑着，手里的打火机却开了又关，开了又关。
Nico认得这个动作。Theo每次上台前紧张，就这样。

zh.hint: Theo说他很高兴，可手一直停不下来。他刚说完不回来了，你心里还堵着。怎么接？

opts.t: 正常就好。省得我明早还得送你去机场。
then: 话是这么说，Theo却抬眼看了Nico一下。

opts.t: 要是航班取消了……你就多待一天？
then: 他问得很轻，好像真的在等一个答案。

opts.t: Nico伸手把打火机从他手里抽走：“别按了，再按没气了。”
then: 哎！那是我的幸运打火机！
Theo伸手去抢，Nico举高，他扑了个空。

zh.title: 有人冲进来了
zh.txt: 门被一把撞开，一个浑身湿透的人冲了进来。

zh: 是Rowan。护士服外面套着雨衣，裤腿湿到膝盖。
Rowan反手把门顶上，甩了甩头发上的水。
外面全淹了。打不到车，渡口街的水到小腿了。
Rowan说着，目光落在Theo身上，停了很久。
说了啊。五年，不回来了。你干嘛这么看我？
他说“挺好”的语气，一点都不像挺好。
Theo“噌”地站起来，一把搂住Rowan的肩膀，把他往吧台推。
Nico看看Theo，又看看Rowan。这俩人，有事。

zh.hint: Rowan话说一半，被Theo硬生生堵了回去。你兜里还揣着那张签名“T”的第六张账单。

opts.t: Nico掏出那张账单，在Rowan眼前晃了晃：“你那张我记着呢。这张，是不是你付的？”
then: 签的是T。我叫Rowan，R开头。上过小学吧？
吧台那边，Theo倒酒的手一抖，洒了半杯。

opts.t: Rowan，你刚才说合同怎么了？
then: Rowan看了Theo一眼。Theo在他背后拼命摇头。
我说……合同挺厚的。纸挺好。

opts.t: Nico扔过去一条干毛巾：“先擦擦。感冒了还得我伺候你。”
then: 我是护士。到底谁伺候谁？
Rowan擦着头发，凑近Nico，压低了声音。
今晚盯紧他。他心里有事。

zh: 行了，安排一下。今晚就在这儿过夜，卡座拼一拼。Nico，有毯子吗？
储物间里只有两条毯子，外加一箱去年圣诞剩下的圣诞帽。
圣诞帽好啊，保暖，还喜庆。
毯子不够没事，我跟Nico挤一张卡座就行。

zh.hint: Theo当着所有人说要跟你挤一张卡座。Wren已经在偷笑了。

opts.t: 你睡地上。老板睡卡座，这是规矩。
then: 我是今晚的主角！主角睡地上？
主角明天睡飞机，今晚睡地上，挺好。

opts.t: 行啊。你别打呼就行。
then: Theo愣了半秒，好像没想到Nico会答应。
我……我不打呼。我睡觉可安静了。
他打。我跟他住了三年，他打，还说梦话。

opts.t: Nico从箱子里掏出一顶圣诞帽，默默扣在Theo头上。
then: 意思是，你今晚只配有帽子。
Theo顶着圣诞帽一脸委屈，全场笑疯了。

zh: 这时，Ethan一声不吭，抓起外套就往门口走。
你们睡吧。我走回去，就二十分钟。
Mason“噌”地站起来，三步跨到门口，用后背把门堵死了。
我膝盖肿不肿，关你什么事？
哦对，关你事。你最爱管我膝盖了——都管到教练那儿去了。
屋里一下子安静了。Wren悄悄把录音笔往前推了推。
是你告诉教练的！你凭什么替我做决定？！

zh.title: 当众吵翻
zh.txt: 冷战了一整周，今晚当着所有人炸了。

zh: 我练了一整年，就为了那场决赛！你一句话，我坐了一整场板凳！
你要是上了，现在就该坐轮椅了！
Ethan伸手去推Mason，膝盖一软，整个人往前栽。
Mason一把接住他。Ethan甩开他的手，扶着门框才站稳。
哎哎哎，二位！我的送别局，别给我整成散伙局啊！

zh.hint: Ethan和Mason在门口顶上了，谁都不让。你是这儿的老板，你得出手。怎么劝？

opts.t: Nico一巴掌拍在吧台上：“门是我的。要吵出去吵——哦，出不去。那就都给我坐下！”
then: Ethan张了张嘴，一个字都没说出来。
Wren“噗”地笑出声，赶紧捂住嘴。
帅。我宣布，今晚最佳男配角——老板！

opts.t: Ethan，你要走我不拦。你先从门口走到吧台，走得稳，我亲自给你开门。
then: Ethan走了三步，膝盖一软，扶住了椅背。
没人说话。Ethan自己慢慢坐下了。
Mason别过头去，拳头攥得发白。

opts.t: Ethan，换我是Mason，我也会说。
then: 行。你们都对。就我是傻子。
Ethan把外套往椅子上一摔，坐到了最远的角落。
Mason看了Nico一眼，很轻地点了下头。

zh: Rowan把一袋冰“啪”地拍在Ethan面前。
敷上。我是护士，不是来跟你商量的。
别谢我。冰是Mason刚才去冰柜拿的。
Ethan低头看着那袋冰，半天没动。
Rowan经过Mason身边，低声扔下一句。
门你堵得住。嘴你堵不住。有话直说。
Mason没吭声，耳朵红到了脖子根。
Nico一抬头——Wren的座位空了。她什么时候溜的？

zh.hint: Wren躲进洗手间给你打电话。她明明就在十米外。
lines: wren
别找了，我在厕所。别出声，听我说。
wren
他刚才说什么你听见没？五年！不回来了！
wren
五年，Nico！五年后你都三十二了！
wren
纽约多少帅哥你知道吗？会演戏、会做饭、还会说法语的那种！
wren
你给他调了五年酒，他连你喜欢他都不知道。
wren
你再不说，我替你说。播客标题我都想好了——《调酒师的五年暗恋》。
wren
……开玩笑的。但我是认真的。今晚不说，你这辈子都别说了。
wren
还有，厕所没纸了。记得补。
then: Nico压低声音回了一句：“你先给我出来。”
电话挂了。Nico一转身，Theo正趴在吧台上看着他。
skip: Nico按掉了电话。三秒后，一条消息弹出来：“怂。”

zh.hint: Theo问是谁打来的。你总不能说“Wren在厕所逼我跟你表白”吧。

opts.t: 推销的。问我要不要贷款。
then: 大半夜推销贷款？这么敬业。
你借点呗，给我升个头等舱。

opts.t: 我妈。问我吃饭没。
then: 你妈晚上十一点打电话问你吃饭没？
……替我跟阿姨问好。上回她给我包的饺子，我到现在还记着。
Nico愣了一下。那是三年前的事了。

opts.t: Wren。她让我……少喝点。
then: Wren让你少喝？她自己在厕所喝着呢吧。
洗手间门口，Wren探出半个脑袋，冲Nico比了个抹脖子的手势。

zh: 老板，反正走不了，再来一杯。
我跟你说，你要是还记得我每次点什么，那我就……
那我就……给你家写个五星好评。

zh.hint: Theo要“老样子”。五年了，他每次点什么，你还记得吗？
then: Theo接过杯子，先低头闻了一下，然后笑了。
一样没错。连杯子都是我常用的那个，缺了个口的。
五年了，你怎么记得这么清楚？
Wren在他背后冲Nico比口型：“说——啊——”
skip: Theo看着推过来的一杯啤酒，挑了挑眉。
行吧，啤酒也行。反正你倒什么我都喝。

zh.hint: Theo问你为什么记得这么清楚。Wren在他背后疯狂使眼色。

opts.t: 你点了五年，傻子都记住了。
then: Theo喝了一口，嘴角一直没下来。

opts.t: 你的事，我都记得。
then: Theo端着杯子的手，停在了半空。
吧台那头，Mason突然很响地咳了一声。
Theo回过神，猛喝一大口，呛得直咳嗽。

opts.t: Nico敲了敲账单：“记这么清楚，是因为你每次都赊账。”
then: 冤枉！我哪次不是抢着买单？
你抢着买单，然后让Nico记账。

zh: Rowan看了眼吧台上Theo的手机，屏幕亮着。
Theo，纽约那边又发邮件了。催你呢。
Theo把手机翻过来，扣在吧台上。
Nico心里咯噔一下。催什么？不是都定了吗？
十一点十五。Rowan在拼卡座，Wren在找充电器，Mason和Ethan各坐一头。
Theo把手机屏幕转过来给Nico看——航班还是“暂时正常”。
你说，这雨要是下一整夜，它还能正常吗？

zh.hint: 只剩你们俩了。他在问航班，可听着又不只是在问航班。

opts.t: 能。纽约在等你呢，老天爷都不敢拦。
then: Theo笑了一下，笑得有点勉强。
老天爷要是都听你的就好了。

opts.t: 不知道。你……希望它正常吗？
then: 我要是说我不知道，你会不会觉得我挺没出息的？

opts.t: Nico没说话，往他杯子里又添了一点。
then: 你每次不知道说什么，就给我倒酒。
五年了，我都摸出规律了。
你刚才问我，航班取消了会不会多待一天。
else: Theo转着杯子，看了很久窗外。
这雨，下得跟要留人似的。

zh: Theo放下杯子，声音压得很低，低到只有Nico听得见。
说真的——你觉得我该去吗？
Nico的心跳漏了一拍。他张开嘴——
脚底下“轰”的一声巨响，像有人把一整缸水砸进了地下室。
地下室的门缝底下，水正一股一股往外冒。
Theo的问题，就这么悬在了半空。
en: 11 PM. Five phones shrieking at once. The bar is total chaos.
Nico shoves the sixth tab into his pocket. The folded note is still unread.
The rain's so heavy the streetlight across the street has disappeared.
Red alert! Listen — "All subway service suspended. Severe flooding on the airport expressway."
Oh, his trip's essential. New York. Five years. Not coming back, remember?
That one lands. The table goes cold for half a second.
Theo's thumb is flying over his phone.
Good news! My flight is — "currently on time."
Obviously. Five-year deal, lead role. Who wouldn't be?
He's grinning. But the lighter in his hand goes click open, click shut, over and over.
Nico knows that move. It's what Theo does backstage when he's nervous.

en.hint: He says he's thrilled, but his hands won't stop. He just told everyone he's not coming back, and it's still stuck in your chest. What do you say?

opts.t: Good. Saves me the drive to the airport.
then: Who said you were driving me?
He says it, but his eyes flick up to Nico anyway.

opts.t: And if the flight gets canceled... you stay one more day?
then: One more day. And then what?
He says it softly, like he actually wants an answer.

opts.t: Nico plucks the lighter out of his hand. "Quit it. You'll run it dry."
then: Theo grabs for it. Nico holds it up high. Theo misses.

en.title: Someone Bursts In
en.txt: The door bangs open and someone soaking wet stumbles inside.

en: It's Rowan. Scrubs under a raincoat, soaked up to the knees.
Rowan shoulders the door shut and shakes the water out of his hair.
It's flooded out there. No cabs. Water on Ferry Street is up to my shins.
He says it looking at Theo. And he keeps looking.
Yeah. Five years, not coming back. Why are you looking at me like that?
The way he says "great" sounds nothing like great.
Rowan! What're you drinking? On me!
Theo leaps up, throws an arm around Rowan, and steers him toward the bar.
Nico looks at Theo. Then at Rowan. These two are hiding something.

en.hint: Rowan got cut off mid-sentence — Theo practically tackled him. And that sixth tab signed "T" is still in your pocket.

opts.t: Nico waves the tab in front of Rowan. "Yours is on the books. So did you pay this one?"
then: It says T. My name is Rowan. Starts with R. You went to school, right?
Over at the bar, Theo's hand jerks. Half the pour ends up on the counter.

opts.t: Rowan — what were you saying about the contract?
then: Rowan glances at Theo. Behind him, Theo is shaking his head like crazy.
I said... it's a thick contract. Nice paper.
That's a worse lie than any of mine.

opts.t: Nico tosses him a dry towel. "Dry off. If you get sick, guess who's stuck taking care of you."
then: I'm the nurse. Who's taking care of who?
Drying his hair, Rowan leans in close and drops his voice.
Keep an eye on him tonight. Something's eating him.

en: Okay. Plan. We're sleeping here — push the booths together. Nico, got blankets?
The storage room has exactly two blankets. Plus a box of leftover Santa hats.
Not enough blankets? No problem. Nico and I can share a booth.

en.hint: Theo just announced, in front of everyone, that he's sharing a booth with you. Wren is already smirking.

opts.t: You're on the floor. Owner gets the booth. House rules.
then: I'm the guest of honor! The guest of honor sleeps on the floor?
Guest of honor sleeps on a plane tomorrow. Floor tonight's fine.

opts.t: Sure. Just don't snore.
then: Theo freezes for half a second. He didn't expect a yes.
I— I don't snore. I'm a very quiet sleeper.
He snores. Three years I've lived with him. Snores and talks in his sleep.

opts.t: Nico pulls a Santa hat out of the box and silently plops it on Theo's head.
then: It means all you get tonight is a hat.
Theo sits there in the Santa hat looking wounded. Everyone loses it.

en: Then Ethan, without a word, grabs his jacket and heads for the door.
You guys sleep. I'm walking. It's twenty minutes.
Mason's up in a flash. Three strides and he's at the door, back pressed against it.
How is my knee any of your business?
Oh, right. It is your business. You love minding my knee — you took it all the way to Coach.
The room goes dead quiet. Wren slides her recorder an inch closer.
You told the coach! Who gave you the right?!

en.title: It Blows Up
en.txt: A week of silence just exploded in front of everyone.

en: I trained a whole year for that final! One word from you and I rode the bench the entire game!
If you'd played, you'd be in a wheelchair right now!
Ethan shoves at Mason — and his knee buckles. He pitches forward.
Mason catches him. Ethan shakes him off and grabs the doorframe to stay up.
Whoa, whoa! This is my going-away party, not your breakup party!

en.hint: Ethan and Mason are squared off at the door and neither will back down. It's your bar. You have to step in. How?

opts.t: Nico slams his palm on the bar. "That's my door. Want to fight, take it outside — oh wait, you can't. So sit down!"
then: Ethan opens his mouth. Nothing comes out.
Wren snorts and slaps a hand over her mouth.
Damn. I hereby name tonight's Best Supporting Actor — the owner!

opts.t: Ethan, I won't stop you. Walk from the door to the bar. If you can do it without limping, I'll open the door myself.
then: Three steps in, his knee gives. He grabs a chair back.
Nobody says anything. Ethan slowly sits down.
Mason looks away, his fists clenched white.

opts.t: Ethan — if I were Mason, I'd have told him too.
then: Great. You're all right. I'm the idiot.
Ethan throws his jacket on a chair and sits in the farthest corner.
Mason looks at Nico and gives the smallest nod.

en: Rowan slaps a bag of ice down in front of Ethan.
Ice it. I'm a nurse. This isn't a negotiation.
Don't thank me. Mason got it from the freezer.
Ethan stares at the ice for a long time. He doesn't move.
On his way past Mason, Rowan says under his breath:
You can block a door. You can't keep blocking your mouth. Just say it.
Mason doesn't answer. His ears go red all the way down his neck.
Nico's phone buzzes. Incoming call: Wren.
Nico looks up. Wren's seat is empty. When did she sneak off?

en.hint: Wren is calling you from the bathroom. She's literally thirty feet away.
lines: wren
Don't look for me, I'm in the bathroom. Don't talk. Listen.
wren
Did you hear what he said? Five years! Not coming back!
wren
Five years, Nico! You'll be thirty-two!
wren
Do you know how many hot guys are in New York? The kind who act AND cook AND speak French?
wren
Five years you've been making his drinks, and he has no idea you're into him.
wren
If you don't tell him, I will. I've got the episode title: "The Bartender's Five-Year Crush."
wren
...Kidding. But I mean it. If you don't say it tonight, you never will.
wren
Also, you're out of toilet paper. Restock.
then: Nico hisses into the phone: "Get out of there."
The call ends. Nico turns around. Theo's leaning on the bar, watching him.
skip: Nico declines. Three seconds later, a text pops up: "Coward."

en: Who was that? Checking up on you this late?

en.hint: Theo wants to know who called. You can't exactly say "Wren, from the bathroom, telling me to confess to you."

opts.t: Telemarketer. Wanted to know if I need a loan.
then: Selling loans at eleven at night? Hustling.
Take one out. Upgrade me to first class.

opts.t: My mom. Asking if I've eaten.
then: Your mom calls at eleven p.m. to ask if you've eaten?
...Tell her I said hi. I still think about those dumplings she made me.
Nico blinks. That was three years ago.

opts.t: Wren. She says I should... drink less.
then: Wren says drink less? She's probably drinking in there.
Wren's head pokes out of the bathroom. She draws a finger across her throat at Nico.

en: Bartender. Since nobody's going anywhere — one more.
Nico's hand pauses on the glass.
Tell you what. If you still remember what I always order, then I'll...
Then I'll... leave you a five-star review.

en.hint: Theo wants "the usual." Five years — do you still remember exactly what he orders?
then: Theo takes the glass, sniffs it, and breaks into a smile.
Every detail. Even the glass — my chipped one.
Five years. How do you remember all that?
Behind him, Wren mouths at Nico: SAY. IT.
skip: Theo looks at the beer Nico slides over and raises an eyebrow.
Fine. Beer works. I'll drink whatever you pour me anyway.

en.hint: Theo's asking how you remember so well. Behind him, Wren is giving you the eyes.

opts.t: You've ordered it for five years. An idiot would remember.
then: Theo takes a sip. He can't stop smiling.

opts.t: I remember everything about you.
then: Theo's glass stops halfway to his mouth.
At the far end of the bar, Mason coughs. Loudly.
Theo snaps out of it, gulps his drink, and chokes on it.

opts.t: Nico taps the tab. "I remember because you never pay it off."
then: Lies! I always fight for the check!
You fight for the check, then tell Nico to put it on your tab.

en: Rowan glances at Theo's phone on the bar. The screen is lit up.
Theo. New York emailed again. They're pushing.
Theo flips the phone face-down on the bar.
Something catches in Nico's chest. Pushing for what? Isn't it a done deal?
11:15. Rowan's pushing booths together, Wren's hunting for a charger, Mason and Ethan sit at opposite ends.
By the window, it's just Nico and Theo.
Theo turns his phone around to show Nico. Flight status: still "currently on time."
If it rains like this all night... you think it'll stay on time?

en.hint: It's just the two of you. He's asking about the flight — but it doesn't sound like he's only asking about the flight.

opts.t: It will. New York's waiting. Not even the weather would dare.
then: Theo smiles. It's a little forced.
I wish the weather listened to you.

opts.t: I don't know. Do you... want it to be?
then: If I said I don't know... would you think I'm pathetic?

opts.t: Nico doesn't say anything. He just tops off Theo's glass.
then: Every time you don't know what to say, you pour me a drink.
Five years. I've figured out the pattern.
Earlier you asked if I'd stay another day if the flight got canceled.
else: Theo turns his glass and stares out the window a long time.
This rain. It's like it's trying to keep someone here.

en: Theo sets his glass down. His voice drops so low only Nico can hear.
Honestly — do you think I should go?
Nico's heart skips. He opens his mouth—
A huge crash from under their feet — like a whole tank of water just smashed into the basement.
Water is pulsing out from under the basement door.
And Theo's question just hangs there in the air.
